content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having a straightforward issue and couldn't find a solution online. In the software, I am unable to select download or upload options. Although I'm connected to my [product_name] module using a standard cable and communication is functioning—for instance, I can sync the clock and the software detects the hardware—I am still unable to upload or download the program. I'm currently using [product_name] Demo version [version_no]. I also tried [version_no] Demo version, but couldn't establish communication in that one. Thank you for any guidance!
Hi [user_name], This is a limitation of the demo version. You cannot upload or download your program with it. To perform these actions, you need the full version of the software.
Thank you for clarifying; I couldn't locate information about these demo version restrictions.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced a core limitation when using the demo version of [product_name] software—uploading or downloading programs is disabled. This significantly reduces the usefulness of the trial and leads to confusion, as these restrictions aren't clearly documented or indicated in the interface. Many users expect to try essential functions in demo mode and are frustrated when features appear available but are not usable.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to upload and download programs once communication with hardware is working, even in demo mode. They also expect demo software limitations to be clearly documented and easy to find.
